description: `db_pass` is the Postgres password of a project or branch, but the shared secret-name rule can't read the abbreviated name, so it stays a plain string. The spec describes V1CreateAProjectRequest.db_pass (v1CreateAProject input) as 'Database password', and BranchDetailResponseOutput (v1GetABranchConfig output) returns it beside db_host, db_port and db_user, the connection details of the branch database; its sibling jwt_secret is already sensitive. Mark both sensitive. Source: the OpenAPI document in spec-mirror-supabase (2026-11-20).
